observation.command:
nohup bash -c '
for img in pgvector/pgvector:pg15 postgres:15.5-bookworm quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2 maildev/maildev caddy:2.11-alpine dpage/pgadmin4:8.12.0 mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/typescript-node:20-bookworm; do
  echo "=== pulling $img ==="
  docker pull "$img" 2>&1 | tail -2
done
echo "ALL_PULLS_DONE"
' > /tmp/docker_pulls.log 2>&1 &
echo "docker pulls started: $!"
